summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, the thin ignite adapters, the renamed-parameter caller updates, and the five test files. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only, plus grep checks for line length, trailing whitespace, and final newlines, which all passed. The part most likely to fail is the nibabel get_data_dtype assertions in the NIfTI and segmentation tests, which I have not confirmed against the installed nibabel version.
